name: Sit Rep
description: Compact situation report on an abandoned or current chat session. Cross-references live HubSpot, GitHub, Hive board, Gmail and site state. Ends with a single colour status.

sources.hubspot: open tasks matching objective or current TURN

rules: Prefer live system state over chat history
No private contact data in public replies
